routes.name: Machame Route
routes.description: The 'Whiskey Route'. Beautiful scenery through rainforest, moorland and the Barranco Wall. Good acclimatisation and a high success rate.

routes.name: Lemosho Route
routes.description: Quiet, remote start on the west side with wonderful views of the Shira Plateau. One of the best routes for acclimatisation.

routes.name: Marangu Route
routes.description: The 'Coca-Cola Route'. The only route with sleeping huts instead of tents. Same path up and down.

routes.name: Rongai Route
routes.description: Starts from the north, close to Kenya. Drier weather and fewer people — a good choice in the rainy season.
